name: All-Purpose Flour
note: Spooned and leveled, not scooped. Scooping can pack in up to 20% more.

name: Bread Flour
note: Slightly denser than all-purpose due to higher protein.

name: Cake Flour
note: Light and fine; always sift before measuring for accuracy.

name: Whole Wheat Flour
note: Contains the bran, so it measures a touch lighter than white flour.

name: Almond Flour
note: Blanched, finely ground almonds. Packs less than wheat flour.

name: Cornstarch
note: Very fine; used as a thickener. Sift if lumpy.

name: Cornmeal
note: Medium grind. Coarser grinds weigh slightly more per cup.

name: Semolina
note: Coarse durum wheat, denser than regular flour.

name: Granulated Sugar
note: White table sugar. Pours level easily.

name: Brown Sugar
note: Measured firmly packed, the standard for recipes.

name: Powdered Sugar
note: Also called confectioners' or icing sugar. Sift to remove lumps.

name: Honey
note: Heavy liquid. Grease the cup so it releases cleanly.

name: Maple Syrup
note: Pure maple syrup; slightly lighter than honey.

name: Molasses
note: Dense and sticky; measure like honey.

name: Water
note: The reference liquid: 1 cup ≈ 237 g.

name: Milk
note: Whole milk. Skim is marginally lighter.

name: Heavy Cream
note: Also labelled double or whipping cream.

name: Vegetable Oil
note: Applies to canola, sunflower and most neutral oils.

name: Butter
note: 1 US cup = 2 sticks = 227 g. Easiest measured by the wrapper.

name: Cream Cheese
note: Softened, packed into the cup.

name: Sour Cream
note: Spoon in and level; do not pack tightly.

name: Yogurt
note: Plain yogurt; Greek yogurt weighs slightly more.

name: Grated Parmesan
note: Finely grated. Coarsely shredded weighs a bit more.

name: Shredded Cheese
note: Loosely packed shredded cheddar or mozzarella.

name: Cocoa Powder
note: Unsweetened, sifted. Compacts easily so measure gently.

name: Chocolate Chips
note: Standard semi-sweet morsels.

name: Peanut Butter
note: Smooth, at room temperature.

name: Rolled Oats
note: Old-fashioned oats; quick oats pack slightly denser.

name: White Rice
note: Uncooked long-grain white rice.

name: Cooked Rice
note: Fluffed, cooked white rice.

name: Breadcrumbs
note: Dry, fine breadcrumbs. Panko is much lighter.

name: Table Salt
note: Fine salt is dense; never swap 1:1 with kosher.

name: Kosher Salt
note: Flaky; roughly half the weight of table salt per cup.

name: Raisins
note: Loosely packed seedless raisins.

name: Chopped Nuts
note: Average for walnuts, pecans and almonds.

name: Shredded Coconut
note: Sweetened or unsweetened, loosely filled.

name: Mashed Banana
note: About 2 medium ripe bananas per cup.

name: Ketchup
note: Thick tomato ketchup, spooned and leveled.
